title: Morton's tune for a clarinetist and the title 'Why'
summary: Morton plays a tune he composed for a clarinet player who never showed at the recording company; Carew writes words for the chorus.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Well, maybe he was a man, but whoever it was disappointed him. He wrote a tune, and, uh, one night, one night or one afternoon, I tried to get around there when the place wasn't busy, so I wouldn't be interfering with anything. I got around there one afternoon, and he played this thing through, what it was, and I said, well, what's that? He said, a little piece I composed. Composed for a clarinet player, and he was going to meet me down at the United Recording Company down there, and he says he never showed up. And he said, that's the piece. I said, well, that's a nice tune. I said, well, that's a nice tune. Which was that? I said, why? Why? I said, what's the name of it? He said, I called it Y. I said, well, why? He said, no reason. He said, it's just, uh, I think that fits the tune. And I said, well, I said, it's a nice tune. I said, why don't you get words put to it? I said, well, you write words put to it. I'm no writer. I said, what? He said, yeah, you can write words put to it. Go ahead. I said, no. I said, get Martin. Get Sidney Martin. You know, Martin was coming around, and he was sort of a newspaper writer, or a article writer, or something. He said, no, never mind, Martin. He said, here. He wrote it unhanded to me. He says, you write words to it. Well, I cracked my skull. And I finally got words to the chorus. It was just the chorus that he had, I know. I got words to the chorus. I took them down to him, handed it to him. I suppose two or three days later, I passed by again. He said, here, take this. I said, what's that? He said, that's a verse for a while. Write words to that. Write words to that. So I had some more words to do. What were the names of those first couple of pieces you did before I started writing these down here? The earlier stuff you did. you did. Well, that, uh... You want to put this?
